verdict.rationale: The evidence shows a draft/publish separation: edits do not affect the published flow until published, and sensitive projects require approval to publish. That protects the live flow, but it is not a sandbox environment that isolates test runs from production data. Nothing documents a separate test environment, mock data, or isolated test execution. Self-hosting a separate instance would be a user-side workaround, so it earns no credit.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can test against a sandbox environment without touching production data
